items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: Lena put her young daughter, Keo, in the swimming pool at the Sands

ctx.x: Bob was an unnecessarily cruel, big, imposing man. But he was a nice fellow. But he was always into trouble. And something else I want to say, that I remember time Lena Horne was working at the Sands, packing them in, Stanley, in Las Vegas. Lena put her young daughter, Keo, in the swimming pool at the Sands, left her in there, let her play around and swim.

Of course, naturally, she was going to be back and forth at the Sands. Now, she stayed at the Sands also, those big stars like that. Me -- I'll get to that. So -- no, I couldn't stay at the Sands. Stayed in a cottage across from the Sands or out somewhere. But Lena Horne put her daughter in the swimming pool, and do you know they drained all the water out of that pool --
